title: Bi-Attention HateXplain : Taking into account the sequential aspect of data during explainability in a multi-task context

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Generalized Mean of Bias (GMB-AUC) combining Subgroup-AUC, BPSN-AUC, and BNSP-AUC metrics to evaluate the model's ability to distinguish toxic from normal comments within sensitive communities (e.g., racial, religious, and gender groups) and to measure false positive tendencies when these groups are mentioned.
